candidates.text: `Complete relief' is not synonymous with `universal relief.' It is a narrower concept: The equitable tradition has long embraced the rule
candidates.speaker: Barrett
phrases: Complete relief is not synonymous with universal relief
candidates.reason: States the governing test: relief is limited to what gives each plaintiff with standing complete relief, not universal relief.
